height_rule_text.value: The R-2 District permits a maximum residential building height of 40 feet above Design Flood Elevation (DFE).
height_rule_text.quote: The R-2 District permits a maximum residential building height of 40 feet above Design Flood Elevation (DFE).

density_rule_text.value: The number of residential units (i.e., density) allowed is determined by dividing the site area by 660 and rounding to the closest whole number.
density_rule_text.quote: The number of residential units (i.e., density) allowed is determined by dividing the site area by 660 and rounding to the closest whole number.

residential_permitted.quote: The purpose of this district is: ... to otherwise reinforce the residential characteristics of this district by restricting uses and structures not compatible with district objectives.

special_conditions.text: Rear yard setback is the lesser of 30 ft or 30 % of lot depth.
special_conditions.quote: Rear yard: 30 ft. or 30% of lot depth, whichever is less.

special_conditions.text: Front yard may be 0 ft or match adjacent side setbacks, but not exceed 10 ft.
special_conditions.quote: Front yard: 0 ft. or match the setback on the adjoining lots on either side except that no front yard setback shall exceed 10 feet.

special_conditions.text: Side yard setback may be 0 ft or 5 ft.
